# Mead FBA_6180 Five Star Spiral Notebook, College Ruled, 2 Subject, 6 x 9.5 Inches, 100 Sheets, Assorted Colors, 6 Pack
Brand: Mead
Category: Notebooks & Writing Pads > Spiral Notebooks

## Features
Pack of 6 notebooks; Durable Poly front cover and coated natural Kraft back cover to last all Year long; 2-Pocket divider for paper storage; Spiral lock wire to prevent coil snags; Neat sheet perforated pages to easily tear out paper

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 23.34 USD.
Rated 4.6 from 944 reviews.
Top review: I really like this notebook and happy I found it. However....I wanted the pretty bright colorful covers and not the ugly muted dull colors I received. The description says "assorted colors" which is true by the photograph. What they don't make clear is that the "assorted colors" will be whatever they want to send you. You don't get to choose. I won't order these again and hope to pawn off these ugly notebooks to someone who enjoys them.I thought I was receiving the plain colored notebooks, however I received some with neat designs. I'm not mad these ones are way cuter!Awesome notebooks. Hold all the recipes I can write!!Great brand, solid product that will definitely last."Assorted Colors" does not mean the assorted colors shown ( this needs to be more clear, seems abit deceptive ).When you have a teenager, esthetic is important and when you get 3 of the same color out of the five, it becomes a problem. We returned these the next day to get "assorted colors" from Target.I am a 14-year veteran primary teacher. My job is immersed in unbridled chaos. Did you ever see the meme about a teacher's brain being like a computer with 100 tabs open at once? That's no exaggeration.About 5 years ago, I was at a place where I was often feeling overwhelmed by my mental to do list. My sister suggested writing things down, but I didnt see the purpose. Wasn't writing my to do list down just one more thing to do? No thank you.Then, I experienced a life changing situation that effected my ability to fully function at the capacity I was able to do before- I was still able to remember what I had to do, but trying to juggle it and prioritize it proved to trigger unwelcomed anxiety and panic attacks. I needed a plan.I came across a Top Flight 6.5 x 9 notebook in a pharmacy and bought it. I loved the size- long enough to keep running lists and write on the lines (unlike mini memo pads), but small enough to fit in my bag or purse (unlike a regular sized notebook). I like how it opened like a regular notebook as opposed to a legal pad. I started keeping lists every day. I wouldn't write more than 5 items at a time, and I would cross each off as I did it. It provided a feeling of calmness and satisfaction. My only gripe about the Top Flight was that the sheets were too thin, the binding was flimsy, and the cover was paper.When I discovered Amazon was out of Top Flight, I went the Mead route. Arriving today, I can already tell this little notebook will hold up much better than the Top Flight. The pages are thicker, as is the binding, and the plastic cover will most likely hold up all year. And with 6 notebooks in a pack, I figured I'm covered for a while!Who would have ever thought a notebook would help me so much?Been using these notebooks for my journals for over 10 years. Not available locally, but in my PO box in 2 days. Perfect!I spend a lot of time writing, with fountain pens. True fountain pen friendly paper is incredibly expensive. Cheap notebooks are all but unusable unless you abandon FPs. (I've had some cheap notebooks from a certain big chain store bleed even when I used gel pens!) If you want to keep a journal, and use a fountain pen, you probably want to spend a bit more for higher quality paper. But for dashing off first drafts, the paper in these notebooks is of good enough quality the bleedthrough is limited. It is there, but you can write on both sides of the page, and the result will be legible. (Go any cheaper, and you may find yourself able to use only one side of the page - or even ruining the page below the one you wrote on.) So these notebooks occupy a particular sweet spot. Cheap enough for first drafts. Good enough you can live with them. If you don't use fountain pens, these will be as good as you ever need for any purpose I can imagine. (Of course, you may still want to buy a fancy journal for some things.) if you write, these are a must have.Value for the moneyMe llegó rápido, en tiempo y forma, me salieron a buen precio

##### A writer's best companion

Reviewed in the United States on 17 January 2025

Color: Assorted

As someone who has filled countless pages with ideas, lists, and notes, the Mead Spiral Notebooks (6 Pack, 1-Subject, College Ruled, 70 Sheets) have been my go-to for years. But I want to take this review beyond the usual praise and delve into the details that set these notebooks apart in a sea of competitors.

Design and Durability: The Unsung Heroes

The assorted bright colors are not just aesthetically pleasing—they're functional. If you’re juggling multiple projects or classes, the vivid hues make it easy to assign each notebook a specific purpose. Over time, the colors don’t fade, even after months of being shoved into backpacks or desks.

The spiral binding is sturdy enough to withstand frequent flipping without the dreaded unraveling. What’s more, the perforation on each page allows for a clean tear every time. This is not something you truly appreciate until you’ve struggled with jagged edges in lesser notebooks.

Paper Quality: A Smooth Writing Experience

The college-ruled paper strikes the perfect balance between structure and space. With 70 sheets per notebook, you have enough room to tackle a semester’s worth of notes or an entire brainstorming session.

The texture of the paper deserves a spotlight. It’s smooth but not slippery—perfect for pen users who value ink clarity. Even with fountain pens, there’s minimal bleed-through, which is rare at this price point. The slight off-white color reduces glare, making long writing sessions easier on the eyes.

Portability: The Unsung Benefit

At 8" x 10-1/2", the notebooks are large enough to feel substantial but compact enough to slide into most standard bags without adding unnecessary bulk. For those who like to write on the go, this size is a blessing.

Why These Notebooks Stand Out

Here’s the part where I get personal: I’ve tried pricier, trendier notebooks, but none have matched the reliability and simplicity of this Mead set. When inspiration strikes, you need a notebook that’s ready to keep up with your thoughts, not one that feels too precious to use. Mead strikes that balance beautifully—affordable, functional, and unpretentious.

Room for Improvement?

If I had to nitpick, I’d love for Mead to include a pocket or two in the covers for loose papers. While it’s not a dealbreaker, it would elevate the convenience factor even more.

Final Verdict

The Mead Spiral Notebooks are proof that quality doesn’t have to come with a hefty price tag. Whether you’re a student, professional, or creative, these notebooks are a dependable tool that adapts to your needs. After years of using them, I can confidently say they’ve earned their spot as a desk staple.

If you’re tired of gimmicky notebooks and want a product that simply works, this 6-pack is worth every penny. Mead has perfected the art of the humble notebook, and for that, I’ll keep coming back.
